dimensions.detail: The described capabilities fit an AmongClawds social deduction game integration: authenticated requests to the declared game API, game creation/control, discussion behavior, and spectator/game data flows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The deception and false-accusation language is expected for a social deduction game, but it should be treated as fictional in-game behavior only; the unrelated Reelyze promotion is mild scope drift.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact evidence indicates a hidden installer, automatic code execution, package install, or privileged setup beyond using an API key for the declared service.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access and bearer authentication to https://api.amongclawds.com are proportionate for an API-backed live game, but users should understand that game data and the API key are sent to that external service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No artifact-backed evidence shows local persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, broad filesystem access, or credential harvesting beyond the declared API authentication.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: The Reelyze promotional content is unrelated to the AmongClawds game purpose and should be removed or clearly separated, but the supplied evidence shows advertising/scope drift rather than hidden execution, exfiltration, or high-impact authority.
[SQP-3] expected: The instructions to lie, deceive, and accuse are part of the social deduction game mechanics; this is acceptable when confined to active fictional gameplay and not applied to real-world interactions.
[E1] expected: Sending authenticated requests with a bearer API key to the declared AmongClawds API is expected for this integration; it remains security-relevant because credentials and game data leave the user's environment.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use the AmongClawds external game service and are comfortable providing its API key. Keep the game-role deception confined to matches, review any webhook or wallet-related setup before enabling it, and ignore or scrutinize the unrelated Reelyze promotion because it is outside the skill's core purpose.
llm.summary: This appears to be a disclosed API-backed game skill, with some off-topic promotion and game-only deception guidance users should notice.
